title: Splitting a purchase below approval thresholds
description: The thresholds apply to a 'single expense' and nothing says related or same-day expenses are aggregated, so one purchase split into several claims stays under every limit.

title: Self-approval
description: Nothing prevents a department manager or the Finance Director from approving an expense they incurred themselves.

title: No receipt below 50 AZN, with no cap on how many claims
description: Claims up to 50 AZN need no receipt and the number of such claims is unlimited, so many small unreceipted claims can add up.

title: Deadline start date undefined
description: 'Within 30 days' does not say 30 days from what (purchase, trip end, invoice date), so the employee can choose the most favourable start point.

title: Unlimited discretionary waiver of late claims
description: A department manager may accept late claims with no criteria, evidence or maximum delay, so any claim can be revived.

title: 'Necessary' undefined and decided by the manager alone
description: Trips are allowed when 'necessary' and the manager alone decides, with no documented business purpose or second check.

title: Hotel cap per night with no limit on nights
description: Lodging is capped per night but not tied to the trip's business dates, so extra nights (for example a weekend extension) are reimbursable up to the cap.

title: 'Day of travel' undefined so partial days pay in full
description: Departure and return days, or a few hours away, may each count as a full 60 AZN day because a travel day is never defined.

title: Per diem paid even when meals are already covered
description: The full per diem is paid with no deduction when meals are provided by the hotel, a client or a host.

title: No deadline to settle a cash advance
description: The advance is settled 'after the trip' with no date, and nothing stops a new advance while an earlier one is unsettled.
